capability.title: Site Header
capability.description: Sticky site-wide header for a restaurant brand: wordmark link, primary navigation resolved from page and external targets, a permanent Order Now action, and a mobile navigation sheet. It renders once from layout.header and owns no page h1.
useWhen: Every page needs the shared brand navigation and the ordering entry point
avoidWhen: A single page needs a local in-content navigation strip or section jump bar
